main_text.p: possint. Resp. Inspiciantur utriusque partis doctorum codices, & lo-gè aliud deprehendes: quòdsi verò nonnulli exorbitent, inde nihil decedit veritatis, qua gaudemus, professioni. At non est quòd miremur hujusmodi dicteria Jesuitica. respondeat August. epist. 137. Hic mos est, inquit, hæreticorum. crimina objicere doctoribus, quum nō possunt reprehendere doctrinam.

Antefignanos Protestantium studu-isse [?] fictis & falsis miraculis auditores suos seducere, at frustra. Ita Calvinum Brullum mortem simulantem excitare voluisse: Lutherum autem Dæmonem expellere. at summâ cum ignominiâ doctrinæ & personarum. Resp. Quibus auctoribus, quibus testibus? Belseco, Cochlæo, Staphylo, Bellarmino, Costero. At stultum est, ait Bellarminus lib.4. de eccles.milit.cap.14. § Sed respondemus, credere de rebus, auctoribus iis, qui non interfuerunt, potius, quàm qui interfuerunt. Absitque damnentur protestatium docto-

page.notes: Long s is printed as a plain s throughout. "studu-isse": the line-end hyphen after "studu" is faint, so the word is marked [?]. The printed text at the end of the page ("docto-") continues on the next page. The printed "August" form is reproduced as "August" with the long s normalised. "Absitque" and "Belseco" are as printed, with "Absitque" possibly misread.
